description: Risk Data Library collection in the World Bank Data Catalog is a data resource listed in Risk Data Library, an initiative and catalogue for disaster and climate risk data, published or maintained by GFDRR, World Bank. It is a collection in the World Bank data catalogue holding datasets used for or produced by disaster and climate risk assessments and curated by GFDRR. Coverage: worldwide, dataset by dataset. The collection page is a script-driven application; its dataset list was not readable with the tools used, so its individual datasets are not yet catalogued. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the page read. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-gfdrr-risk-data-library-standard.
licence: not stated on the page read
